'''Hazefyre Axe Armorbeast''' is an [[Elite enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|An axe armorbeast corrupted by hazefyre. The creature has become extremely aggressive, having been driven into a state of rabid insanity. Approach with caution if you do not intend to be split in half by its "great axe".}}

==Overview==
An [[Axe Armorbeast]] that has been corrupted by hazefyre, the Hazefyre Axe Armorbeast has similar appearance with its counterpart. While they retain most of the abilities of their normal relatives, they also have unique abilities as well: 

*Thrusts its horn upwards after a short step, dealing Physical damage.
*Rolls to either left or right, dealing Physical damage, but makes it immobile for a short period.
*Lifts up its limbs before a heavy landing, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back.
*After a short delay, charges ahead, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back. After repeating this two more times, thrusts its horn upwards and deals Physical damage.
*Lifts up its limbs before a heavy landing, dealing Physical damage. After that, the Hazefyre Axe Armorbeast will charge up, then deals Physical damage to a wide area ahead, and knock Operators back. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
